title: Day Four of the New Reality: Ward Assignments and Radical Integrity
summary: On day four following an emergency evacuation, President Hughes details plans for isolated, returning, and reassigned missionaries, noting the miraculous return of senior couple Elder and Sister Cross. He outlines a strategy shifting missionaries to online ward-centric service under local bishops, urging them to master online video presentation. To combat stress, he introduces a 10-second box-breathing relaxation exercise. Finally, he warns against slipping into casual habits at home, demanding exact obedience to smartphone safeguards and a strict adherence to personal integrity.
